recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, warm-toned studio portrait of a male figure with voluminous 1970s-style hair and prominent sideburns, featuring a soft-focus background and elegant serif typography positioned in the upper-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face occupies the right two-thirds of the frame
Warm, hazy light source originates from the left, creating a soft glow
Text is anchored in the negative space created by the subject's shoulder
The intricate texture of the patterned collar contrasts with the smooth skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait, slightly off-center to the right, filling the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright highlight on the bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the textured collar, then sweeps up to the typography in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left quadrant, providing a canvas for the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers (background and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value in highlights, creating a nostalgic, hazy atmosphere.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Descenders that may overlap with lines below
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' dots replaced with small graphic icons (e.g., a heart)
Extended swash on the tail of the 'g'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with varying sizes or weights for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small heart icon used as a tittle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s editorial feel and rounded serif nature
Provides the vintage, slightly soft-edged look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man with 1970s hair and sideburns, wearing a shirt with a large, textured lace-patterned collar. Use warm, amber lighting and a hazy, dark brown background. Leave the top-left corner relatively clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply two lines of left-aligned serif text in the top-left corner. Use a cream fill with a thin dark brown outline. Replace the dot on any 'i' with a small red heart icon. Ensure tight line spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and hazy?
Is the collar texture clearly visible?
Does the text have a thin outline?
Is the subject's hair styled in a 70s volume?

adjustableVariables: Specific icon used for the 'i' dot
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and brand logos
Exact catalog numbers in the corners
Specific facial features of the original person
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the eyes
Check that the heart icon is small and integrated into the text
Verify the color palette remains strictly warm-toned
Confirm the 'glow' effect doesn't wash out facial details
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus 70s portrait + Warm Amber Lighting + High-Contrast Outlined Serif + Textured Apparel Detail
